doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Brunies reunion visit at the Laine house and photos in the yard
summary: Blanche describes the day Georgie, Abbie and Merritt visited, shows yard photos, and Rudy Brunies's son Henny; Wiggs says that nephew booked him across the river and followed his band.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Yeah, that's my, this is Murray, you see? Yeah, uh-huh. And I believe he came down that day. See, there's the Brunus. Oh, yeah. Merritt, Georgie was down too, that's Abby. That's Georgie, yeah. And that's Merritt, yeah, that's Papa. In the yard here.
Right in the yard.

Right in the yard, yeah. Uh, Georgie had been down then, you see? He got two sticks, he's got a drum, a tub, a wash tub. Yeah, he had them taken, I believe he's got a couple more, yeah, there they are again, yeah. The doctor got some of these pictures, I don't know which one he wanted them. Papa told him he could take them. And there's the hole, he took the hole bunch there. That's Merritt and his wife, that's my daughter and my grandchild. That's Brunis' nephew, that's the guy, yeah, you know him? He died recently? Rudy, Rudy Brunis, that's his son, that's his son, Henny. Call him Henny Brunis too, Henny, yeah.
